files.description: Source 2 base game-event protobuf messages.  Provides the Source 1-legacy game-event bridge (CMsgSource1LegacyGameEvent), sound-system events (SoS), and surface-decal events.  Identified by the EBaseGameEvents enum (200–212).

messages.description: Debug event that reports the current game-session ID string to a specific client.  Used during development to trace session continuity.

fields.description: Slot index of the client receiving the session-ID debug information.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: clientid

fields.description: Unique string identifier for the current game session.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: gamesessionid

messages.name: CMsgVDebugGameSessionIDEvent

messages.description: Instructs clients to paint a decal (bullet hole, blood splatter, spray) onto a surface or entity in the world.

fields.description: World-space hit position where the decal should be placed.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: position

fields.description: Surface normal at the hit position; orients the decal correctly.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: normal

fields.description: Secondary axis vector for texture alignment.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: saxis

fields.description: Bone index when the decal is attached to an animated model (-1 for world surfaces).
fields.label: optional
fields.name: boneindex

fields.description: Decal flags bitmask (temporary, permanent, etc.).
fields.label: optional
fields.name: flags

fields.description: RGBA colour tint applied to the decal texture.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: color

fields.description: Random seed used to select from a decal group variant.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: random_seed

fields.description: Hash of the decal group name (e.g. 'BulletImpactConcrete').
fields.label: optional
fields.name: decal_group_name

fields.description: Override size in world units (0 = use default decal size).
fields.label: optional
fields.name: size_override

fields.description: Entity handle to attach the decal to (0xFFFFFF = world).
fields.label: optional
fields.name: entityhandle

fields.description: Material ID of the surface at the hit point.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: material_id

fields.description: Hash of the decal sequence name for animated decals.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: sequence_name

fields.description: Mesh triangle index for precise placement on complex geometry.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: triangleindex

messages.name: CMsgPlaceDecalEvent

messages.description: Removes all world-surface decals matching the given flags (e.g. clears bullet holes at round start).

fields.description: Bitmask of decal flags; decals with any matching flag will be removed.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: flagstoclear

messages.name: CMsgClearWorldDecalsEvent

messages.description: Removes all decals painted on entity surfaces that match the given flags.

fields.description: Bitmask of decal flags to clear from all entity surfaces.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: flagstoclear

messages.name: CMsgClearEntityDecalsEvent

messages.description: Removes all decals on a specific entity that match the given flags.

fields.description: Bitmask of decal flags to clear.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: flagstoclear

fields.description: Handle of the specific entity whose decals should be cleared.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: entityhandle

messages.name: CMsgClearDecalsForEntityEvent

messages.description: Sent once at the start of a connection to register all Source 1 game-event schemas with the client.  The client uses this list to decode subsequent CMsgSource1LegacyGameEvent messages by ID.
messages.name: CMsgSource1LegacyGameEventList
messages.notes: This is the Source 2 equivalent of the Source 1 'svc_GameEventList' message. All classic CS:GO game events (player_death, bomb_planted, etc.) are transmitted through this bridge.

messages.description: Registers which Source 1 game-events a specific client wishes to receive. Used by plugins and spectators to opt in to event streams.

fields.description: Player slot that is registering these event listeners.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: playerslot

fields.description: Packed bitmask array; bit N set means listen for game-event with ID N.
fields.label: repeated
fields.name: eventarraybits

messages.name: CMsgSource1LegacyListenEvents

messages.description: Carries a single Source 1 game-event (player_death, weapon_fire, bomb_planted, etc.) over the Source 2 network layer.  The event-type name and all key–value pairs are encoded inside the keys list.

fields.description: String name of the game event (e.g. 'player_death', 'bomb_planted').
fields.label: optional
fields.name: event_name

fields.description: Numeric event ID assigned during registration via CMsgSource1LegacyGameEventList.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: eventid

fields.description: Typed key–value pairs carrying event-specific data (integers, floats, strings, booleans).
fields.label: repeated
fields.name: keys

fields.description: Server tick on which the event was fired.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: server_tick

fields.description: Passthrough flag used internally by the event system.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: passthrough

messages.name: CMsgSource1LegacyGameEvent
messages.notes: CS2 game events (player_death, round_start, bomb_exploded, etc.) are all transmitted as CMsgSource1LegacyGameEvent messages.  Use the event_name field to identify them and CMsgSource1LegacyGameEventList to decode keys.

messages.description: Starts a named sound event through the SoS (Sound Operating System) layer, associated with an optional source entity.

fields.description: Unique integer handle for this sound instance (used to stop or modify it later).
fields.label: optional
fields.name: soundevent_guid

fields.description: CRC32 hash of the sound event name string.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: soundevent_hash

fields.description: Entity index of the sound source (-1 = world/positional).
fields.label: optional
fields.name: source_entity_index

fields.description: Random seed for sound variation selection.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: seed

fields.description: Packed binary parameters for the sound event (volume, pitch, position, etc.).
fields.label: optional
fields.name: packed_params

fields.description: Game time at which the sound should start playing (allows latency compensation).
fields.label: optional
fields.name: start_time

messages.name: CMsgSosStartSoundEvent

messages.description: Stops a specific sound instance identified by its GUID.

fields.description: GUID of the sound instance to stop (matches soundevent_guid from CMsgSosStartSoundEvent).
fields.label: optional
fields.name: soundevent_guid

messages.name: CMsgSosStopSoundEvent

messages.description: Stops all sound instances matching the given sound-event hash on the specified source entity.

fields.description: CRC32 hash of the sound event name to stop.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: soundevent_hash

fields.description: Entity index to restrict the stop to (-1 = stop all matching sounds).
fields.label: optional
fields.name: source_entity_index

messages.name: CMsgSosStopSoundEventHash

messages.description: Updates runtime parameters of an active sound event without restarting it (e.g. volume fade, pitch shift on a looping ambient sound).

fields.description: GUID of the active sound instance to modify.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: soundevent_guid

fields.description: New packed parameter values to apply to the running sound.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: packed_params

messages.name: CMsgSosSetSoundEventParams

messages.description: Modifies fields in a named sound library stack (a group of sound layers), allowing global sound-mix changes from the server.

fields.description: CRC32 hash of the sound library stack name to modify.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: stack_hash

fields.description: Packed binary field values to apply to the stack.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: packed_fields

messages.name: CMsgSosSetLibraryStackFields

files.name: gameevents.proto

files.description: Foundational proto-type definitions shared across all CS2 network and game-event messages.  Provides compact vector, angle, quaternion, colour, and player-info structs used as fields in higher-level messages.

messages.description: Compact three-component world-space position or direction vector transmitted over the CS2 network.  Used for shot origins, positions, normals, etc.

fields.description: X component of the vector (world units).
fields.label: optional
fields.name: x

fields.description: Y component of the vector (world units).
fields.label: optional
fields.name: y

fields.description: Z component of the vector (world units, positive = up).
fields.label: optional
fields.name: z

messages.name: CMsgVector

messages.description: Two-component vector for screen-space or 2D positions.

fields.description: X component.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: x

fields.description: Y component.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: y

messages.name: CMsgVector2D

messages.description: Euler angle triplet (pitch, yaw, roll) used to represent orientations in CS2 network messages.  Pitch = up/down, Yaw = left/right, Roll = tilt.

fields.description: Pitch angle in degrees (positive = look down).
fields.label: optional
fields.name: x

fields.description: Yaw angle in degrees (positive = turn left).
fields.label: optional
fields.name: y

fields.description: Roll angle in degrees.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: z

messages.name: CMsgQAngle

messages.description: Unit quaternion representation of a 3D rotation, used when higher precision or gimbal-lock avoidance is needed.

fields.description: Quaternion X component.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: x

fields.description: Quaternion Y component.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: y

fields.description: Quaternion Z component.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: z

fields.description: Quaternion W (scalar) component.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: w

messages.name: CMsgQuaternion

messages.description: Combined position and orientation transform message.

fields.description: World-space translation vector.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: position

messages.name: CMsgTransform

messages.description: 32-bit RGBA colour value transmitted as four separate byte-range integers.

fields.description: Red channel (0–255).
fields.label: optional
fields.name: r

fields.description: Green channel (0–255).
fields.label: optional
fields.name: g

fields.description: Blue channel (0–255).
fields.label: optional
fields.name: b

fields.description: Alpha channel (0 = fully transparent, 255 = fully opaque).
fields.label: optional
fields.name: a

messages.name: CMsgRGBA

messages.description: Compact player-identification record stored in the 'userinfo' string table.  Every connected client has an entry here; used to resolve entity handles to Steam IDs and display names in demo parsers.

fields.description: Steam display name of the player (UTF-8, up to 32 bytes).
fields.label: optional
fields.name: name

fields.description: Steam's internal 64-bit XUID (may differ from SteamID64 for certain account types).
fields.label: optional
fields.name: xuid

fields.description: Session-scoped integer user ID assigned by the server (unique per connection).
fields.label: optional
fields.name: userid

fields.description: 64-bit SteamID64 of the player.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: steamid

fields.description: True when this slot is occupied by a bot rather than a human player.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: fakeplayer

fields.description: True when this slot is a GOTV/HLTV proxy connection.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: ishltv

messages.name: CMsgPlayerInfo

messages.description: Wrapper that targets an entity-specific message to a specific entity handle.

fields.description: Packed entity handle of the target entity (0xFFFFFF = broadcast).
fields.label: optional
fields.name: target_entity

messages.name: CEntityMsg

messages.description: List of convar name–value pairs, used to synchronise convar state between client and server (e.g. in CNETMsg_SetConVar).
messages.name: CMsg_CVars

messages.description: No-operation message; sent as a heartbeat or padding packet.
messages.name: CNETMsg_NOP

messages.description: Per-tick synchronisation heartbeat sent from the server to all clients. Carries host-performance metrics alongside the current tick number.

fields.description: Current server tick number.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: tick

fields.description: Server computation time for this tick in microseconds.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: host_computationtime

fields.description: Standard deviation of recent computation times in microseconds.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: host_computationtime_std_deviation

fields.description: Unsmoothed frame time in microseconds.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: host_unfiltered_frametime

fields.description: GOTV replay control flags.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: hltv_replay_flags

fields.description: Tick number that is expected to take longer than usual (pre-warned to clients).
fields.label: optional
fields.name: expected_long_tick

fields.description: Percentage of server frames dropped, multiplied by 10 (e.g. 15 = 1.5%).
fields.label: optional
fields.name: host_frame_dropped_pct_x10

messages.name: CNETMsg_Tick

messages.description: Client→Server string command (e.g. 'joingame', 'spectate', 'changeteam'). The server whitelists valid commands; arbitrary console commands are not accepted.
messages.name: CNETMsg_StringCmd

messages.description: Pushes a list of convar values from the server to the client (or from client to server when the client is reporting user settings).
messages.name: CNETMsg_SetConVar

messages.description: Reports the current connection stage of the client or server during the multi-step sign-on sequence.

fields.description: SignonState_t enum: NONE=0, CHALLENGE=1, CONNECTED=2, NEW=3, PRESPAWN=4, SPAWN=5, FULL=6, CHANGELEVEL=7.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: signon_state

fields.description: Incremented each map load; used to detect map changes.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: spawn_count

fields.description: Number of player slots currently occupied on the server.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: num_server_players

fields.description: List of SteamID strings for currently connected players.
fields.label: repeated
fields.name: players_networkids

fields.description: Current map name.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: map_name

fields.description: Comma-separated list of workshop addons loaded on this server.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: addons

messages.name: CNETMsg_SignonState
